style_icon: Art style: premium casual mobile game asset, glossy stylized 3D render, smooth soft-touch plastic, silicone and rubber materials, soft studio lighting from the top-left with crisp specular highlights, vibrant saturated candy colors, clean rounded shapes, cute and satisfying.
